name: Misha
source:
December 23rd. It’s almost time for Christmas.
You play as Helen, spending a quiet evening at home with her sweet calico cat, Misha.

What begins as an ordinary evening—warm lights, gentle cuddles, soft meows—might not stay that way.

[From [url=https://thanursan.itch.io/misha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
12月23日。快到圣诞节了。
你扮演海伦，和她可爱的印花猫米莎在家里度过了一个安静的夜晚。

一个普通的夜晚开始时——温暖的灯光、温柔的拥抱、轻柔的喵喵声——可能不会一直这样。

[来自[url=https://thanursan.itch.io/misha]itch.io[/url]]
